item.title: 383-Powered 1967 Chevrolet Chevy II Nova SS
item.description: This 1967 Chevrolet Chevy II Nova SS two-door sport coupe was purchased by the seller in 1989, and refurbishment work completed in 2014 involved the installation of a 383ci stroker V8 along with a 700R4 four-speed automatic transmission. The body was repainted in gold with black stripes, and the interior was re-trimmed using gold seat upholstery and coordinated carpeting and trim. item.title: 427-Powered 1968 Ford Mustang GT500CR 5-Speed by Classic Recreations
item.description: This 1968 Ford Mustang was built by Classic Recreations in 2021 as one of the company's GT500CR models in the style of the 1967 Shelby GT500 Super Snake continuation model.
